description: Non-material amendment to planning permission ref. 23658/APP/2023/2980 dated 11-10-2024 (Minor Material Amendment (S73) to Conditions 2 (Approved Plans), 3 (Approved Documents) and 23 (Landscaping Scheme for Health Centre Development) of planning permission ref. 23658/APP/2021/1296, granted 31-08-2023 for: Partial demolition, refurbishment and extension of the existing Cottage Hospital to provide a state of the art health centre and the comprehensive redevelopment of the remaining Site to provide residential (Use Class C3) accommodation and ancillary works including car parking, cycle parking, landscaping and associated works (Phased Development)) to replace approved boundary bollards with a 1.2m high boundary fence incorporating a sliding vehicular gate and pedestrian gate, creation of a defined pedestrian footpath route from Pinner Road to the main entrance, and minor re-arrangement of boundary tree planting to accommodate gate foundations (no tree loss proposed).

Condition 23 (Health centre landscaping) of planning permission reference 23658/APP/2023/2980 dated 11-10-2024, is amended to:
Prior to the commencement of above ground works on the health centre, a landscape scheme shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The scheme shall include:-
1. Details of Soft Landscaping;
1.a Planting plans (at not less than a scale of 1:100),
1.b Written specification of planting and cultivation works to be undertaken,
1.c Schedule of plants giving species, plant sizes, and proposed numbers/densities where appropriate to include pollution absorbing trees.
2. Details of Hard Landscaping
2.a Refuse Storage
2.b Cycle Storage
2.c Means of enclosure/boundary treatments with the Pinner Road boundary treatment to not exceed 1.2m in height (AMENDED);
2.d Car parking layouts:-
- 51 parking spaces including 5 disabled compliant parking spaces
- 1 'active', 1 rapid charger and 50 'passive' electric charging points
- 2 mobility sc
Condition 47 (Gate Opening) of planning permission reference 23658/APP/2023/2980 dated 11-10-2024, is added as follows:

The vehicular gates hereby approved shall remain open during the operational hours of the health centre and shall only be closed outside of these hours. The gates shall be operated in such a manner that vehicles do not wait on the public highway or obstruct the footway.
REASON
In the interests of highway and pedestrian safety, in accordance with Policies T4, T6 and T6.1 of the London Plan (2021) and Policy DMT 2 of the Hillingdon Local Plan: Part Two (2020).
Condition 48 (Gate Details) of planning permission reference 23658/APP/2023/2980 dated 11-10-2024, is added as follows:
Notwithstanding the approved plans, the boundary treatment hereby approved shall be implemented in accordance with the approved plans and details, including:
- Brick piers to match the brickwork of the existing historic frontage building;
- Coping in natural or reconstituted stone; and
- Fencing finished in a dark colour.
The development shall be retained as such thereafter.
REASON

To ensure a high quality design and to preserve the character and appearance of the site and surrounding area, in accordance with Policies D3 and D4 of the London Plan (2021) and Policies DMHB 11, DMHB 12 and DMHB 5 of the Hillingdon Local Plan: Part Two (2020).

Notwithstanding the non-material amendment hereby approved, other than condition 2 and 23 which is superseded by the above condition, and new conditions 47 and 48, all other conditions relating to Planning Permission Ref: 23658/APP/2023/2980 dated 11-10-2024 must be discharged/adhered to as per that permission.
